newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end flat after dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end flat after dull trade.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures finished barely changed after quiet trade on Wednesday, with the strong dollar offsetting the metal's decline in London overnight, traders said.
"We couldn't do anything. Volume's too thin," said one trader at one of Japan's major trading houses. "Individual investors are not really interested as we've seen little price movements."
The benchmark June contract added 0.2 yen to 187.0 yen, while the April lost 0.1 yen to 188.2 yen. Others were between down 0.1 yen and 0.6 yen. Estimated volume was 1,504 lots.
In London overnight, aluminium ended down $21 at $1,563 per tonne, faced with uncertainties in copper which saw backwardation remaining wide at $250/$255.
